text: Partial latent encoding is a nonlinear optimization capability, not a FittedProjection. The portable fixed-step solver admits only entry losses with a certified global curvature bound; Poisson and ordinal blocks therefore fail closed pending backtracking or projected capabilities. Uniqueness is certified only from positive ridge curvature or a full-rank observed quadratic decoder Gram; all other cases report NotCertified rather than inventing identifiability.
